subject: Gas smell in kitchen
body: Hi, I need someone urgently. There's a strong gas smell coming from around the kitchen stove. It's been getting stronger over the last hour. I've turned off the stove and cracked a window but I'm worried. Can someone come check this today? — Maria, Pelican Court

subject: Radiator leaking onto bedroom floor
body: Hello, the radiator in the back bedroom has been leaking onto the floor since last night. I've put towels down but it keeps coming back. Could someone take a look this week? Thanks, James, Pelican Court

subject: Intercom not buzzing guests in
body: Hi there, the front door intercom panel isn't buzzing guests in. It's been broken for about 3 days now. My guests have had to call me to come down and let them in. Could this get fixed? Thank you, Soo-Jin, Unit 8B

subject: Dishwasher not draining
body: Hi, my dishwasher fills with water but won't drain — there's standing water pooling at the bottom after every cycle. Started two days ago. Let me know when someone can come take a look. Kevin, Unit 8B

subject: Noise complaint – upstairs neighbor
body: Hi, the neighbors upstairs have been really loud again late at night this week. Wondering if building management could send a reminder about quiet hours? Thanks, Sara

subject: Parking spot reassignment request
body: Hi, is it possible to switch my assigned parking spot? Mine is quite far from the entrance and I noticed a few closer spots seem to be open. Thanks, Astrid, Unit 2B

subject: AC unit not cooling
body: Hello, the AC unit has stopped cooling properly over the past two days. It's just blowing warm air now. It's been quite uncomfortable. Could someone take a look soon? Yuna, Unit 5

subject: Mailbox lock broken
body: Hi, my mailbox key won't turn anymore. I think the lock mechanism itself is broken. Could someone from maintenance take a look? Darnell, Unit 14C

subject: Front door lock not latching
body: Hi, my front door isn't latching properly anymore. I have to slam it to get it to lock. Worried about security. Could someone fix the latch mechanism? Carlos

subject: Can I paint the living room?
body: Hi, I was hoping to paint the living room a light blue. I noticed the lease doesn't specify any restrictions on paint colors. I'm happy to restore it to the original color when I move out. Let me know if that's alright. Thanks, Priya, Unit 3C
